lines.en: I float half a foot up, moving quietly.
My white robe brushes the ground.

lines.zh: 一路走，我一路看着四周
lines.en: I watch all around as I go.
I am the attendant; I walk behind.

lines.zh: 脚步不重，落地也不出声
lines.en: Light steps; I make no sound landing.
I know this area. Follow me.
I raise a hand for you to follow.
Flying is easier, but I like walking.

lines.zh: 我转过拐角，先看有没有人
lines.en: I round the corner and check for anyone.

lines.zh: 衣角被风掀起来，我按住
lines.en: Wind lifts my hem; I hold it down.

lines.zh: 我的速度不快，但从不误事
lines.en: I'm not swift, but I never arrive late.
We'll take this small path. It's safe.

lines.zh: 我站得笔直，手垂在身侧
lines.en: I stand straight, hands at my sides.
I'm waiting for you to decide where to go.

lines.zh: 这地方的气很杂，我不喜欢
lines.en: The ki here is muddled; I dislike it.
I close my eyes and listen a while.
I keep track of everything I must do.
If someone needs me, I'm here.
I look at the sky and judge the hour.

lines.zh: 我的职责比我自己重要
lines.en: My duty matters more than I do.

lines.zh: 风把袍子吹得贴在身上
lines.en: The wind presses my robe to my body.
I let out a quiet breath.
I'm waiting for a signal.

lines.zh: 我的气收得很匀，不外放
lines.en: My ki stays even, never flaring.
I look down and check my cuff.
Standing like this isn't wasted time.
You're not from here, are you?
I watched you a long while before speaking.
Your ki is clean. Rare.
Stay back; I want a clear look at you.
I incline my head — a small courtesy.
Looking for someone? I can guide you.
I don't trust strangers easily.

lines.zh: 你的手上没有伤，说明你没打过硬仗
lines.en: No scars on your hands; you haven't fought hard yet.

lines.zh: 我抬手，先示意你别靠近
lines.en: I raise a hand for you to keep back.
Your eyes don't look cruel.

lines.zh: 我把你的样子收进记忆。
lines.en: I file your face away in memory.
If you're an enemy, withdraw now.

lines.zh: 这一带很危险，你要小心
lines.en: It's dangerous here. Be careful.
I ask; you answer.
I don't care for roundabout talk.
Your ki is shifting. Why?
I'm waiting for you to state your business.
Fine. I'll trust you once.
I swallow this little pain.

lines.zh: 这一下打偏了，但碰到了
lines.en: It went wide, but it grazed me.
I step back and reset my stance.
There's a tear in my robe.
I press the wound; my ki wavers.
It hurts. I can bear it.
I look up; my expression hasn't changed.
Blood seeps through; I ignore it.
I draw a breath and steady myself.
I'll remember that blow.
I don't need these.
You test me with food?
I shake my head, slightly.
An attendant shouldn't covet such things.

lines.zh: 如果是给别人的，我替你拿着
lines.en: If it's for someone else, I'll carry it.
I'm not hungry. Thank you.
Keep it for yourself.

lines.zh: 我瞥了一眼就不再看了
lines.en: One glance, then I look away.
That won't buy my loyalty.
I appreciate the thought.
My apologies; I wasn't watching my feet.
I step aside to let you pass first.
You bumped me — are you hurt?

lines.zh: 这通道太窄，我们排成一列
lines.en: The passage is narrow; we go single file.
My robe caught on you.
I step back and steady myself.
Careful — don't tread on my hem.
I don't mind, but watch where you go.
I put a hand out to steady you.
A bump like that isn't worth mentioning.

lines.zh: 我的职责在先，感情在后
lines.en: Duty first; feeling after.

lines.zh: 我不会许下做不到的承诺
lines.en: I won't promise what I can't keep.

lines.zh: 并肩同行，就是我能给的
lines.en: Walking beside you is what I can offer.
If you leave, I'll remember.
We don't need many words.

lines.zh: 我护着你，直到这事结束
lines.en: I'll guard you until this is over.
Don't lose your life here.
I'll wait here for your return.
This isn't a pact, only company.
Staying alive matters more than anything.
I pick it up and dust it off.
This belongs to you, doesn't it?
I'll keep it safe until it's needed.
Things shouldn't be left lying about.
I bend and lift it, steady.
Too heavy; it'll take two trips.
I put it in my pouch.

lines.zh: 掉在路边，总会有人踩到
lines.en: Left by the path, someone would step on it.
Whose is this? I'll hold it for now.
I count them; none missing.
Something ahead; I stop.
Someone's hiding behind that tree.
That ki means no good.
I raise a hand for you to fall back.
I fix my eyes on that direction.
This one comes to fight. I'm ready.
I quiet my breathing and listen to the steps.
That's no stray beast.

lines.zh: 我向前一步，把你挡在后面
lines.en: I step forward and put you behind me.
Let me see who it is first.
My ki begins to gather.
Its ki is growing heavier.
Don't panic. I'm here.
This opponent is no simple matter.
I recognize that attire.
What must come will come.
I won't strike in haste.

lines.zh: 它的重心偏左，我看见了
lines.en: Its weight favors the left. I saw it.
I wait for it to move first.
The distance closes; I hold my ground.
I circle it, looking for an opening.
I'll make this one count.
It's testing me.
My heartbeat stays steady.

lines.zh: 它的气在往上走，要出手了
lines.en: Its ki rises; it's about to strike.
I take half a step back to make room.
I can see its hands now.
Just a moment more.
I hold my ki in, letting nothing show.
The gap is at its shoulder.

lines.zh: 我不会给它第二次机会
lines.en: I won't give it a second chance.
I wait until it raises its hand too high.
I move on three.
It retreats; I follow in.
I strike fast, just once.
The ki blast leaves my palm.

lines.zh: 我打它的关节，不打要害
lines.en: I hit its joints, not its vitals.

lines.zh: 杰比特的手，先给你个警告。
lines.en: Kibito's hand offers a warning first.
Small blasts cut off its retreat.

lines.zh: 我贴身近打，不让它拉开
lines.en: I stay close so it can't make space.

lines.zh: 我的手背扫过它的侧脸
lines.en: The back of my hand sweeps its cheek.

lines.zh: 它挡得住第一下，挡不住第二下
lines.en: It blocked the first; not the second.

lines.zh: 我一边打一边看它的反应
lines.en: I watch how it reacts as I strike.
I held back on that blow.
I turn and drive my elbow into its ribs.
Ki bursts in my palm.
It's knocked back.
I don't pursue; I look first.
Fall back. I don't want to strike again.
That should give you something to think about.

lines.zh: 我落在地上，衣袍先着地
lines.en: I land, robe settling first.
I didn't come by chance.
Someone asked, so I came.

lines.zh: 这地方的气，我一下就能读出好坏
lines.en: I can read the ki of a place at once.
I straighten first, then look around.

lines.zh: 我的出现总是有原因的
lines.en: There's always a reason for my appearing.
The ground is level — good for landing.
Wind spreads the hem of my robe.
I stay silent and listen first.

lines.zh: 这里的天空和我记忆里不同
lines.en: The sky here is not as I remember.

lines.zh: 我抬手，收起最后一点气
lines.en: I raise a hand and draw in the last of my ki.
This task calls for care.
I shut my eyes to confirm the direction.
Someone's near me — very weak.
I come down from the sky without a sound.
I am Kibito. Remember that.
First, I confirm what needs confirming.

lines.zh: 这具身体不算强，但够用
lines.en: This body isn't strong, but it will do.

lines.zh: 袍角烧起来，我拍了两下
lines.en: My hem catches fire; I beat it out twice.

lines.zh: 落地时没稳住，膝盖一沉
lines.en: I didn't land clean; my knee buckled.

lines.zh: 水比我想的深，气快用完了
lines.en: Deeper than I thought; my breath is nearly gone.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推得倒退好几步
lines.en: The blast throws me back several steps.
Something grazed my arm.
This spell is tearing at my ki.
I've gone too long; my limbs are weak.
Lightning falls; my vision goes white.
I missed my footing and fall.
